title: Restored register position
statement: Let a call specification have an ordered list of register indices, and let $rp_0$ assign an integer position to each register. For a natural number $a$, define the restored position of register $r$ to be $0$ if $r$ occurs in that list at an index less than $a$; otherwise define it to be its position $rp_0(r)$.
